## Domain analysis and decisions

### Service scope and dependencies (`service_scope`)

Define the persistence service, environments, consumers, and upstream and downstream dependencies.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Configuration and capacity baseline (`configuration`)

Record version, configuration, capacity forecast, cost, and performance measurement.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Service objectives (`slo`)

Specify approved availability, performance, RTO, and RPO values and measurement points.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Backup and recovery (`recovery`)

Record backup cadence, recovery exercises, data integrity, and failure action.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Change and release control (`release_control`)

Set environment isolation, release gates, compatibility, rollback, and configuration-drift checks.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Monitoring on-call and handoff (`runbook`)

List alerts, incidents, on-call coverage, escalation, and the operations calendar.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Go or no-go decision (`go_no_go`)

Summarize test evidence, blockers, exceptions, and named launch approval.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
